newsitem.title: RUSSIA: BASKETBALL-CSKA VICTORIOUS IN RUSSIAN CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-CSKA VICTORIOUS IN RUSSIAN CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: CSKA Moscow clinched the Russian basketball championship on Sunday for the sixth consecutive season, beating Avtodor Saratov 103-93 in their fifth and final play-off.
Avatador, who overcame bitter CSKA objections to stage play-off games at their tiny arena in Saratov, had levelled the series to 2-2 on Friday when they beat CSKA in the fourth game.
CSKA has now earned a place in the Euro-League next season.
In a surprise result, Samara won third place by beating Dynamo Moscow in their fifth play-off 76-74.
